comments.body: Landed 2026-10-29 (a75d0870..593dc098): every group this daemon keeps or holds a replica of, as metadata in the snapshot; GroupMade/Changed/Deleted and Logged (bodies in live events); msg.history pages (after, through] newest-first within 4 MiB; Unread carries the human's place and what waits, shared with the attention topic. Design reviewed by Codex xhigh (2 P1 taken), code by Codex and Claude (P2s fixed). Stage 3 left: replica home identity, groups with no member here.
comments.author: Alexander Terp

creator: Alexander Terp
description:
MIP-10 stage 1, part 3 of 5: the messages topic. Read docs/mip/0010-api-for-other-tools.md sections 3, 4 ("Messages") and 7.

What: every group this daemon keeps or holds a replica of, in the snapshot as metadata only: name, home daemon by stable identity, members, policy, paused, the number of its latest post, and the human's place in it. `msg.history` pages a group's posts, bounded by bytes per page, from any number up to the number the snapshot was current to; the live stream carries posts after it. A deleted group, or one whose earlier posts are gone, says so. Events: a post; a group made, changed or deleted; a participant joining or leaving; the human's place moving. Reading and fetching move nobody's place. Groups on other machines with no local member come in stage 3, not here.

Proves: a gate test client resubscribing after a disconnect fetches only the pages it lacks and misses nothing; a backlog of 1 MiB posts arrives in pages under the frame limit; a read at the desk (`muster msg read --as @human`) shows up as the human's place moving.
title: MIP-10 stage 1c: the messages topic, paged history and the human's place
